title: Inzwi Rakaramba Kuora Mwoyo
intro: Pinda mumhuri umo kurasikirwa kunotevera kurasikirwa, asi inzwi rimwe chete rakadzikama rinoramba kuora mwoyo. Kushevedzera kamwe chete muKorani kunoshandura mwoyo murefu kuita shanduko; unogona here kutsvaga zviratidzo zvemunhu ari shure kwezwi iroro?
clues: Ndaiva inzwi remwoyo murefu mumba umo makomborero aiedzwa nenjodzi.
Ndakaramba ndiri mumba musina vanhu nekuda kwekurasikirwa nepfuma nevana.
Ndaiziva kuti chirwere chakanga chabatawo shamwari yake, ine muviri wairwara.
Ndakapa chirevo chimwe chete: Allah ndiye Chokwadi, saka rambai muine mwoyo murefu.
Ndakadana kuna Ayyub nezita; mushure mezvo, Allah akabvisa dambudziko racho ndokudzorera mhuri.

trial.answer: Kuramba naAyyub munguva yekurasikirwa nekurwara, wobva wakumbira mwoyo murefu

location.answer: Kuzivisa kuti Allah ndiye Chokwadi uye mwoyo murefu unodiwa

options: Dambudziko raAyyub rakabviswa uye mhuri yake yakadzorerwa
Mwana akamirirwa kwenguva refu akapihwa mushure memunamato usina kubereka
Mutongi wechidiki akadudzira makore manomwe ezvakawanda nekushomeka
Mwana aitarisirwa akanunurwa kubva mumvura inoyerera
outcome.answer: Dambudziko raAyyub rakabviswa uye mhuri yake yakadzorerwa
